name: ChatGPT
bestFor: Everyday questions, writing help, ideas, images and learning anything step by step
about: ChatGPT is the AI assistant from OpenAI. You type (or speak) a question or a task, and it answers in plain language. It can write, explain, translate, summarise, plan, make images and read files you upload.
It is the best place to start if you are new to AI. One app covers most daily jobs, and the free plan is enough to learn how it works.
useCases: Write emails, posts, CVs and cover letters
Explain a hard topic in simple words
Summarise a long PDF or article
Plan a trip, a study timetable or a business idea
Make images from a description
Practise English or prepare for an interview
features: Chat by text or voice, on the web and on phone apps
Upload PDFs, images and spreadsheets and ask questions about them
Web search with links to sources
Memory and custom instructions so it remembers your preferences

howToUse.title: Create an account
howToUse.text: Go to chatgpt.com or install the app and sign up with Google, Apple, Microsoft or an email address.

howToUse.title: Say who you are and what you need
howToUse.text: Start with context: "I am a university student in Lahore. Help me...". The more it knows, the better the answer.

howToUse.title: Give the task and the format
howToUse.text: Say exactly what you want back, for example "5 bullet points", "a table" or "under 150 words".

howToUse.title: Improve the answer in the same chat
howToUse.text: Reply with changes: "make it shorter", "more formal", "add examples". You don't need to start again.

howToUse.title: Check facts before you use them
howToUse.text: Ask it to search the web and show sources for anything important, then open the links yourself.

tips: You can type in Urdu or Roman Urdu and ask for the answer in either language.
Paste an example of the style you like and say "write in this style".
Use Projects to keep chats and files for one subject together.
examplePrompt: I am applying for a junior marketing job. Here is the job post and my CV. Write a cover letter under 250 words in simple, confident English and list 3 things I should change in my CV.
limitations: It can sound sure and still be wrong. Check names, numbers and dates.
The free plan has limits on uploads, images and deep research.
Don't paste passwords, bank details or private documents you aren't allowed to share.
freePlanDetails: Daily chat with limits on uploads, images and deep research.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Gemini
shortDescription: Google's AI assistant for chat, writing and research.
bestFor: People who use Gmail, Google Docs and Android and want AI built into them
about: Gemini is Google's AI assistant. It works like a chatbot on the web and in its phone app, and it is also built into Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Android phones.
Its strengths are Google Search, YouTube and long documents. It can read a long PDF or video and answer questions about it.
useCases: Summarise a long email thread in Gmail
Ask questions about a YouTube video
Draft a document in Google Docs
Research a topic with Google Search results
Make images and short videos
features: Connects to Gmail, Drive, Docs, YouTube and Maps when you allow it
Very long context: it can read big files in one go
Deep Research writes a report with sources
Gemini Live for talking to it by voice on your phone

howToUse.title: Sign in with your Google account
howToUse.text: Open gemini.google.com or the Gemini app. Your normal Gmail account is enough.

howToUse.title: Ask your question
howToUse.text: Type the task with some context and the format you want, just like any chatbot.

howToUse.title: Turn on apps if you want them
howToUse.text: In settings, connect Gmail, Drive or YouTube so you can ask things like "find the invoice email from last week".

howToUse.title: Use Deep Research for big questions
howToUse.text: Choose Deep Research, describe what you need, approve the plan, and wait a few minutes for a report with sources.

tips: Paste a YouTube link and ask "give me the main points with timestamps".
Use the "Double-check" option to see which sentences Google Search supports.
Students sometimes get paid plans free for a period. Check Google's student offers.
examplePrompt: Read the PDF I uploaded and make a one-page study sheet: the 10 most important terms with simple definitions and 5 likely exam questions.
limitations: Some features need a paid Google AI plan.
Like all chatbots it can make mistakes, so check important facts.
Features arrive in different countries at different times.
freePlanDetails: Check the website for current limits.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Microsoft Copilot
shortDescription: Microsoft's free AI assistant, also built into Word, Excel and Windows.
bestFor: Free everyday chat, and AI inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint
about: Microsoft Copilot is a free AI assistant from Microsoft. You can use it on the web, in the Windows Copilot app, on phones and inside the Edge browser.
If you pay for Microsoft 365, Copilot also works inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, so you can draft a document or analyse a spreadsheet without leaving the app.
useCases: Ask questions and get answers with web links
Draft a document in Word
Make formulas and charts in Excel
Turn a Word document into PowerPoint slides
Make images from text
features: Free chat with web search and sources
Built into Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook with Microsoft 365

howToUse.title: Open Copilot
howToUse.text: Go to copilot.microsoft.com, open the Copilot app in Windows, or install the phone app.

howToUse.title: Sign in with a Microsoft account
howToUse.text: You can try it without signing in, but an account keeps your chat history and gives more use.

howToUse.title: Ask your question
howToUse.text: Write the task with context and the format you want.

howToUse.title: Use it inside Office (paid)
howToUse.text: With Microsoft 365, open Word or Excel and click the Copilot button to ask for help with that file.

tips: In Excel, ask "explain this formula" or "add a column that calculates profit".
In Edge, open Copilot in the sidebar and ask it to summarise the page you are reading.
examplePrompt: Make a weekly budget table for a student in Karachi with rent, food, transport and savings, and explain how to track it in Excel.
limitations: Copilot inside Word and Excel needs a paid Microsoft 365 plan.
Answers can be wrong. Open the source links for anything important.
freePlanDetails: Free chat, web search and image making with a Microsoft account.
pricingNote: US prices. Microsoft 365 also includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint and 1 TB of storage.

name: DeepSeek
shortDescription: Free AI chatbot that is strong at maths, logic and code.
bestFor: Free help with maths, logic and coding problems
about: DeepSeek is an AI chatbot from a Chinese company of the same name. The chat app is free, and it is especially good at step-by-step reasoning: maths, logic puzzles and code.
Its models are also released openly, so developers can run them on their own computers or servers.
useCases: Solve maths problems step by step
Explain and fix code
Work through logic and reasoning questions
Summarise text and answer general questions
features: Free chat on the web and phone apps
Upload files and images to ask about them

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Open chat.deepseek.com or install the app and sign up with an email address or Google.

howToUse.title: Choose the mode
howToUse.text: Turn on DeepThink for hard maths or logic questions. Leave it off for quick everyday answers.

howToUse.title: Ask your question
howToUse.text: Paste the full problem, including any numbers, code or error messages.

howToUse.title: Check the steps
howToUse.text: Read the reasoning and check each step, especially for homework or work you will submit.

tips: For maths, ask it to "solve step by step and check the answer at the end".
For code, paste the full error message and the code around it.
examplePrompt: Solve this step by step and explain each step simply: a shop gives 20% off and then another 10% off. Is that the same as 30% off?
limitations: Its privacy policy says user data is stored on servers in China. Don't share private or work information.
Answers on some political topics are restricted.
It can be busy and slow at peak times.
freePlanDetails: The chat app is free. Developers pay per use for the API.
cheapestPaidPlan: No paid chat plan. The API is pay as you go.
